title: अपनी अच्छाई कभी मत छोड़ो
description: साधु ने डूबते बिच्छू को बार-बार बचाया, डंक खाकर भी। सामने वाला कैसा भी हो, हमें अपनी अच्छाई और अपना स्वभाव कभी नहीं छोड़ना चाहिए।

scenes.narration: एक साधु ने नदी में डूबते बिच्छू को देखा।
scenes.image_prompt: A stick-figure sadhu with a round head, simple dot eyes, a long white beard, an orange-saffron robe and a wooden walking stick standing on a stone ghat at a village river bank at sunrise, looking down with worried eyes. In the rippling water below a small dark brown scorpion struggles and spins, trying to stay afloat among floating leaves. Detailed stone steps, reeds, soft water ripples and a banyan tree on the bank, a tense caring mood, square composition with the sadhu on the left and the scorpion in the water on the right.
